notes.title: Patch 1.3.1: QoL, Performance and Bugfixes
notes.content:
Sup Gnomies,



In the previous update we added 17 new languages as well as 4 new maps to the game! As a result we've been overwhelmed by huge wave of new supporters as well as the return of so many experienced players. In the last month we welcomed 15,712 new players (and 20,477 new wishlisters).



If you haven't already, please leave us a review on our Steam page, (it really helps us out a lot)



With this update we have tried to address what we can to improve the experience for as many people as possible. Check out the latest changes below:


Maintenance and ChangesQuality of Life
Standalone Leaderboard: includes all time daily run player records and top players of all time.  https://gnomes-leaderboard.live/

Historic Daily Runs: you can now play every daily run ever (your score doesn't count)

Retry Day: When you die, restart at the beginning of the day you died.


Performance
Endless Mode: Improved game speed (Pathing on background thread)


Bug Fixes
Fixed spawning massive amounts of gold coins when the goblin king kills you and you've got blood chalice 

Fixed the z ordering of coins/hearts during end of run menu

Added cap to undo history (1024)


Changes to ItemsBugfixes and Small Changes
Penny Bun: fixed error in description

Ectoplasm: gnomes can no longer be blown up by sappers and nukes when using ectoplasm

Fishing Hook: will now include the tile a gnome is standing on as well as adjacent tiles

Balisong: maximum of -1 damage and up to -75% cooldown 

Rusty Shiv: crit chance up to 35% and cost down to 5 


Shop Prices
Powder Charge: cost reduced to 5 

Whetstone: cost reduced to 5 

Bunk Bed: cost down to 8 

Gold Top: cost reduced to 7 

Pike: cost reduced to 5

Chanterelle: cost reduced to 6


Rarity
Tactics Manual: uncommon to rare

Butterfly: rare to uncommon

Wolf Mantle: uncommon to common

Wolf Claw: uncommon to common

Wolf Heart: uncommon to common 

Hose: uncommon to common



Thank you all for your relentless support of Gnomes and a big shoutout to the members over on the Gnomes Discord Server for the feedback and motivation.



Cheers,

Tommy and Patrick

DYSTOPIAN

notes.title: Patch 1.1: QoL and UI Overhaul
notes.content:
Sup Gnomes,


First of all we wanted to shout out to the wiki crew over here on the community Discord server - if you haven't already Come and Join the Gnomes Discord Server 

The wiki is now fleshed out and well organized. Thank you for your contributions and thank you to those who contacted us with issues and patiently tested debug builds for us - without you it would have been much harder / impossible to track these down. Check out all their hard work here: https://gnomes.wiki.gg/wiki/Gnomes_Wiki

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/188bac705c06a03ae61db86c291001e3674a4739.png"]



If you haven't already, please leave us a review, it really helps us out a lot!


What's going on in this update?
We've been busy addressing feedback and building the infrastructure to allow us to expand the game. Primarily we have focused on solving some rare video issues that some players have been suffering from. We've also put in place a new UI system that will finally allow us to localize the game into different languages. (Our next major update will feature a bunch of new languages.) We've also made a bunch of QoL changes like "click and drag box pickup of multiple entities" as well as massive improvements to the UI of the different menus.

notes.title: Patch 1.04F: Hotfix
notes.content:
Sup Gnomies,

We've done a lot of patches in the last week, trying to be reactive to all the feedback we've had about video and compatibility issues. We've had close to 20,000 different people on different machines playing Gnomes since launch and we underestimated how the quirks of our custom engine would behave with all of your different systems. Thanks sticking with us and for those of you who took the time to help us troubleshoot the issues!

Here's what's new:

 VSync is now disabled by default (it can be a factor in some driver issues e.g. the flickering)
 Settings is now stored in settings.json which is human editable if you need to change settings without opening the game (If settings.json isn't there, launch the game and it will be generated)

This update will cause settings to reset to default, but will hopefully be the last time we need to worry about it!

If you have any more issues or feel like hanging out with us and the Gnomies - come and join us on the Gnomes Discord Server 

Cheers,
Tommy and Patrick
DYSTOPIAN

notes.title: Pre-Release FAQs
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

As some of you may know, Gnomes is made by a small team of two developers, we set out to make a tower defense passion project. Since releasing the demo, Gnomes has exploded in popularity which has been quite overwhelming for us. We never could have anticipated the support we've received for your community and fans. You have our most sincere thanks, this experience has been truly life-changing.

It is our intention to launch a feature complete version game that offers our entire vision of the gameplay experience we wanted to create. We wanted to get the game in the hands of our players as soon as possible, so there are some non-essential features that we will be taking care of post-launch.

Here we will provide are the official answers to some of your frequently asked questions and will continue to make updates here and through official announcements. to keep you informed as things change. 

 Will the Gnomes be available in languages other than English? 
- Not initially, in order to prevent delaying our launch any further we will only be supporting English on launch day. However, we are going to work closely with our community to facilitate language support once we have finished all of the essential "must haves" of the game.

 Is there plans for future Gnomes content? 
- As it stands we have fulfilled our original scope and vision for Gnomes. However, if there is demand from our players and our resources permit, we may add additional content in the future.

  Will the Gnomes include Steam Deck and Controller Support? 
- Only mouse and keyboard will be officially supported at launch. However, the game works very well on Steam deck, and there are already some great community controller layouts. In the future we will add controller support and an officially supported Steam Deck version. However, we want to take the time to do this properly, rather than rushing in a sub par version of either.

 Will mod support/Steam Workshop be available? 
- Not at launch, however we will investigate the technical feasibility of different levels of mod support post-launch pending player demand.

 Will Gnomes have Linux and MacOS support? 
- Gnomes currently works perfectly on Linux with Proton.
- Unfortunately, the MacOS security certification process is impossible for us at this time.

 What game engine was used to create Gnomes and why? 
- We have created a custom game engine using Rust, OpenGL and FMOD. Our custom engine is purpose build for Gnomes which has allowed us to drastically cut development time and resources. However there has been some short comings which still need to be addressed (controller support, localization, etc).

 We will update the FAQs as more questions appear. In the meantime, feel free to join the Discord community if you have any further questions and suggestions: https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2


This post will be archived and will be maintained here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3133060/discussions/0/595145168817005283/

Firstly, thank you everyone who's played the demo so far! We've had almost 2000 new players download the Gnomes first time, welcome everyone who's just joined us!

If you haven't already, make sure you give Gnomes a wishlist, and leave a review (it really helps us a lot!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/f9aea6a02a31785437b13e63626125022ba2eef8.gif

Yesterday we were lucky enough to have two of our favourite creators cover Gnomes on their channels! After watching their videos we noticed a things that we could do better, so we've decided do a quick update that improves the game even more! Here's a couple of videos to check out if you haven't tried Gnomes yet:

Splattercat
[previewyoutube=xQIEtiMXHX8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Olexa
[previewyoutube=EkCyX41rY3w;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



V 0.17 Update
We've just made some changes to the game in the form of 9 NEW RELICS and some bugfixes + QoL changes. Here's what we've been up to:

New Relics

 Green Thumb - When gnome is adjacent to a crop and it kills a goblin, the crop spreads immediately. 
 Sewer Pipe - Swamp tiles now deal 1 damage to passing goblins, but kills any swamp crops.
 Mead - +1 damage to all Gnomes, -50% XP gain
 Tactics Manual - +1 damage to Gnomes when adjacent to a Gnome of a different type
 Red Hat - +1 damage to all level 1 Gnomes
 Herbicide - Weeds can no longer grow on fertile soil
 Shopping Basket - +1 HP each time you purchase something from the shop
 Loin's Mane - +50% XP gain for all Gnomes


Balance

 Increased the cost of a number of different relics
 Lotus and Sawmill cost an additional gold to build


Polish and QoL

 Improved Gnome attack AOE previews in the game world.
 Improved tooltips a bunch of items.
 Improved AOE tooltip in shop menu for "Wolf" items.
 Addition of Hearts & Bells, like Coins for visual and audio feedback when gaining the respective resources
 Explicit types system, types are now shown in type line and referred to in colour in tooltip
 Reworked many tooltips


Bugfixes

 Fixed a crash when using cactus in endless mode at double speed (this was an audio bug caused by too many instances of the cactus SFX playing at once)
 No free reroll after paid reroll when buying dice
 Fixed infinite banishes on last item bug
 Fixed tutorial bugs where it wouldn't progress the house check when placing caravan
 Fixed tutorial locking you when you can't afford to progress it


Thanks for all of your support, wishlist and reviews. You guys are the reason we make games!

All the Best,
Tommy and Patrick
DYSTOPIAN

notes.title: Gnomes Demo Release Date: 29th of November
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We're super excited to announce the official demo of Gnomes will be available to download from the 29th of November 2024!

[previewyoutube=B0xiTXUlcBI;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo will be a feature complete, content locked taste of the the Gnomes experience. Gnomes is a highly repayable game so there should be hours and hours of content for those who really want to get their hands dirty in the garden. 

If you haven't already, make sure you Wishlist Gnomes here on Steam. It helps us out tremendously. We're so excited to finally share Gnomes with you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134742/f9aea6a02a31785437b13e63626125022ba2eef8.gif

Features:

 8 Playable builds including different Gnomes, economy and game changing relics
 3 Procedurally generated maps with unique enemies and waves including: Forest, Swamp and Desert
 Over 60+ relics, items, crops and utilities that allow you to create a different build every run
 Endless mode with exponential difficulty so you can test even the most broken builds


Lastly, we want to say a massive thank you to our community over on Discord. We've had over 250 people help us playtest the Gnomes demo. We couldn't have done this without your feedback and support! If you haven't already, come and join us on Discord >> https://discord.gg/Bw9m5Nuna2


All the Best,
Tommy & Patrick
DYSTOPIAN
